Package neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops

Class CalciumSulfatePhaseBoundaryQualification

java.lang.Object
neqsim.thermodynamicoperations.flashops.saturationops.CalciumSulfatePhaseBoundaryQualification
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class CalciumSulfatePhaseBoundaryQualification extends Object implements Serializable
Independent-evidence qualification of the COMPSALT gypsum/anhydrite phase boundary.

The calculation reuses the authoritative CalcSaltSatauration solubility-product path. For simultaneous equilibrium of anhydrite (CaSO4) and gypsum (CaSO4.2H2O), the dissolved-ion activity product cancels and the required water activity is a(H2O) = sqrt(Ksp(gypsum) / Ksp(anhydrite)). No mineral, Pitzer, electrolyte-EOS, or reaction parameter is fitted or changed by this evidence view.

The declared validation envelopes are from Voigt and Freyer (2023), DOI 10.3389/fnuen.2023.1208582, CC BY 4.0. Bock (1961), DOI 10.1139/v61-228, is the primary experimental lineage for the two NaCl crossing intervals; no primary table row is redistributed here.

      public double getPredictedPureWaterTransitionAtEvaluatedPressureCelsius()
      Returns the COMPSALT pure-water transition prediction at the requested pressure.

      This is a reproducibility diagnostic only. It is not high-pressure qualification because the constant lumped reaction-volume convention does not separately resolve aqueous-species volumes.

      Returns:
      predicted transition temperature in degrees Celsius at the evaluated pressure
